qualificationLimits: Internal cooperative exception projection, no logger/event invocation or shipping serializer. Windows Developer native families/source replay; six exact .NET 10.0.12 roll-forward-disabled children per Windows/Ubuntu with identical managed bytes. Real caller virtual accessors can allocate, block or throw; capture reads Message/StackTrace once itself and propagates accessor failures. AggregateException.Message can read its children inside its own getter. Only retained Unicode prefix is inspected; omitted suffixes are not inspected. Guard/control tests cover declared field access and no mutable source graph retention.
